##### Project general facts

Divyabhav 7 Hills by Reportage Properties is an impressive residential and commercial tower that combines modern architecture, elegant design, and exceptional comfort. The project offers 166 residences, including studios, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, spacious 3 and 4-bedroom duplexes, as well as retail and office spaces.

Residents can enjoy an excellent range of amenities, including a swimming pool, kids' pool, fully equipped gym, outdoor gym, and children's play areas. The development also features a multipurpose hall, lounge terrace, BBQ areas, and shaded seating spaces, creating a perfect environment for relaxation, entertainment, and an active lifestyle.

The residences feature stylish contemporary interiors, thoughtfully designed layouts, and beautiful finishes that create a welcoming and comfortable atmosphere. Each home includes built-in wardrobes, kitchen cabinetry, fully tiled bathrooms, and double-glazed windows, while private balconies and terraces in selected layouts add extra space for relaxation.

##### Location description and benefits

Kololo is one of Kampala, Uganda’s most prestigious and desirable residential areas, known for its peaceful atmosphere, leafy streets, and elegant homes. Its elevated setting offers beautiful views of the city, creating an appealing environment for residents who value privacy, comfort, and a refined lifestyle.

The neighborhood provides convenient access to restaurants, cafés, shopping destinations, and everyday services, making daily life both comfortable and enjoyable. Its selection of dining spots and leisure venues also allows residents to experience Uganda’s vibrant social scene without travelling far from home.

Kololo combines the convenience of urban living with a relaxed residential character, making it an excellent choice for families, professionals, and expatriates living in Uganda. With its established community, green surroundings, and access to Kampala’s key business districts, the area offers an attractive balance of tranquillity, connectivity, and modern living.
